'''Robert Waygood Ham & Cheese''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Robert Waygood]] posted on DeckTech. The post says: 'last Sunday all 3 dark decks this deck played were HDADTJ. I won them all.' (no event named).<ref name="dt-5132">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5132 Ham & Cheese], DeckTech (Robert "Djas Phur" Waygood, 6 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5132/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5132/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018184724/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5132/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Ham & Cheese'''
* '''Author:''' Robert "Djas Phur" Waygood
* '''Published:''' April 6, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' No too hamy, not too cheesy, Just rightA HBX beatdown with numbers

=== Strategy ===

The notes beside each card should suffice as a strategy. Whoooops, forget parsec 1 - 8 rule. replace second dagobah system with another hoth or kashyyyk, whatever takes your fancy. ************Also the strategy beside the astromechs is supposed to say; high destiny, adds power and hyperspeed to corvettes so they can go from coruscant to corulag.************ ************Also beside Toryn and Wedge it is supposed to say; Ability 2 Add 2 pilots with high destiny.

I decided to tell you why each card is/isn't here.



What, I have no Transmission Terminated/s or even spies
Me thinks they are unnecessary. HDADTJ will die quickly, they need Vader down 1 destiny 1 character. They lose lots. I know, last Sunday all 3 dark decks this deck played were HDADTJ. I won them all.
